claim_boundary: The squared-Cauchy Fourier value, sharp scalar Perron limit away from y=1, generic finite Dirichlet-polynomial inversion, and finite von Mangoldt specialization to Chebyshev.psi are Lean-verified. Infinite-series/integral interchange and the full Chebyshev Perron formula remain open; no RH result or novel mathematics is claimed.
verified_units: positive vertical line avoids the pole at zero
complex power equals the exponential-logarithmic kernel for y > 0
finite-height y-form equals the a = log(y) oscillatory form
the constant exp(a*c) factors exactly from the finite-height integral
the scalar and logarithmic open targets are logically equivalent
all finite scalar truncations are interval integrable
at y = 1 the raw integral equals 2*arctan(T/c)
at y = 1 the normalized symmetric limit is 1/2

verified: sharp scalar Perron limit away from the jump
finite von Mangoldt inversion to Chebyshev.psi

open_unit.statement_shape: Justify replacing the full von Mangoldt L-series inside the height-T vertical Perron integral by finite coefficient sums with control compatible with T tending to infinity.
open_unit.why_open: Pointwise absolute summability on Re(s)>1 is verified, but a uniform domination or two-parameter tail estimate is still required to interchange the infinite coefficient limit with the growing vertical integral.
